title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
partTitle: The Kingdom of Heaven Is the Realm of God’s Dominion
summaryZh: 天國是神掌權的領域，耶穌差派我們在地上彰顯天國，醫病趕鬼使神的統治臨到。
lines: We know that He is King of kings and Lord of lords.
我們知道祂是萬王之王、萬主之主。
So let's talk about the Kingdom first.
所以讓我們先來談談神的國。
Let's quickly define ourselves, because I want to make sure we clearly understand the commission that Jesus is giving us.
讓我們先快速為自己定位，因為我想確保我們清楚明白耶穌賜給我們的使命。
First, the Kingdom: the King's domain, the sphere of His rule.
首先是神的國：君王的領域，祂掌權的範疇。
So when you pray for someone who is tormented by demons and that evil spirit comes out, it is because the Kingdom has come.
所以當你為受鬼折磨的人禱告，而那邪靈出來時，那是因為神的國臨到了。
There are no demons in heaven.
Why are there no demons in heaven?
There are probably many reasons, but one of them is that there is no one there who agrees with the devil.
可能有很多原因，但其中之一就是那裡沒有任何人與魔鬼同調。
Consent is what gives it space.
認同妥協給了它立足的空間。
Believing in a lie empowers the liar.
相信謊言賦予了說謊者能力。
So, Jesus preached about the Kingdom of God.
This was His message, this was His practice.
這是祂的信息，也是祂的實踐。
John the Baptist announced the coming of the Kingdom.
施洗約翰宣告國度的臨到。
He taught His students to do the same.
In Matthew chapter 10 it says: "When you enter a city, tell them that the Kingdom has come near."
馬太福音第10章說：「當你們進城時，要告訴他們天國近了。」
Then do the things of the Kingdom.
醫治病人、叫死人復活等等。
So the Kingdom message is really about the manifestation of God's rule here, as it is in heaven.
所以天國的信息，真正關乎的是讓神的統治彰顯在這裡，如同在天上。
So, since there are no evil spirits there, when you encounter one here, you have a task—what to do?
所以，既然天上沒有邪靈，當你在地上遇見邪靈時，你有一個任務——要做什麼呢？
Seek first the Kingdom, that is, what?
先求神的國，那是什麼意思呢？
To seek the very first reign of God that exists there, so that it may manifest itself here in the same way.
去尋求那存在於天上的神的統治，好讓它能以同樣的方式彰顯在地上。
Is that clear, are you with me?
這樣清楚嗎，你們有跟上嗎？
So this is the commission of the Kingdom message.
所以這就是天國信息的使命。
He commanded His disciples to preach it.
祂吩咐門徒也要傳講它。
We see that His last words in Acts, chapter 1, were about the Kingdom.
我們看見祂在使徒行傳第1章最後說的話，就是關於神的國。
The last words of the apostle Paul in Acts 28 were about the Kingdom.
使徒保羅在使徒行傳28章最後說的話，也是關於神的國。
It's not just "it would be nice if you did this too."
這不只是「如果你也順便做這個就很不錯」。
This is central to the Gospel.
這對福音而言是不可或缺的核心。
This is a message that God's reign is being realized here.
這是一個宣告神的主權正在此地被實現的信息。
